cohort: Pregnant women diagnosed with cancer during pregnancy between 2000 and 2022, registered in the International Network on Cancer, Infertility and Pregnancy (INCIP) registry.
finding: Maternal mortality occurred in 5.6% of cancer-in-pregnancy cases and is associated with adverse perinatal outcomes, including fewer live births, more elective caesarean sections, and a lower gestational age at delivery, resulting in more preterm births.
